benchmark_name: Ashcombe & Rowe Estates FAQ RAG Evaluation

results.question: Can I pop into the Chelsea branch on a Sunday afternoon?
results.retrieved_answer: Only our Chelsea branch is open on Sundays, from 11:00 am to 3:00 pm. All other branches and the head office are closed on Sundays.

results.question: Are any of your offices open on Sunday other than Chelsea?
results.retrieved_answer: Only our Chelsea branch is open on Sundays, from 11:00 am to 3:00 pm. All other branches and the head office are closed on Sundays.

results.question: What commission fee do you charge to sell a residential property?
results.retrieved_answer: Our standard sole-agency fee is 1.5% of the agreed sale price plus VAT. Multi-agency is 2.25% plus VAT. There are no upfront costs; you pay only when your sale completes.

results.question: Where is your head office located in London?
results.retrieved_answer: Our head office is at 22 Halden Mews, Mayfair, London W1K 2PX.

results.question: Which local branch handles properties in the Kew area?
results.retrieved_answer: Kew is covered by our Richmond branch at 9 Hill Street, Richmond TW9 1SX (020 7946 0430).

results.question: Is a property valuation free of charge?
results.retrieved_answer: Yes. Our market valuations are free and come with no obligation to instruct us.

results.question: What paperwork and documents do I need to submit an offer?
results.retrieved_answer: To make an offer you will need photo ID, proof of address and proof of funds (or a mortgage agreement in principle). This is required under UK anti-money laundering regulations.

results.question: Do you handle new-build homes priced under £1 million?
results.retrieved_answer: Our new-build service is for homes priced at £1 million and above. Our resale listings cover a wider range of prices, including some homes under £1 million. For anything else, please call our head office on 020 7946 0100.

results.question: Do you offer lettings or property management services?
results.retrieved_answer: No. We focus on sales only and do not currently offer lettings or property management. For rental enquiries please call our head office on 020 7946 0100 and we can recommend a partner agency.

results.question: Are you registered with any professional real estate bodies?
results.retrieved_answer: Yes. We are members of Propertymark and The Property Ombudsman, and we follow their codes of practice.
